name: Release 0.3.1 Documentation Update
description: Review all recent changes, update all documentation including README, and increment version numbers from 0.3.0 to 0.3.1. Ensures documentation accurately reflects current functionality before release.

userStories.title: Review recent changes
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to review all changes since the last release to ensure documentation covers new functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Review git log since last version tag or recent commits
Identify all new features, enhancements, and fixes
Document list of changes for changelog/release notes
Verify all PRDs in archive have corresponding documentation
Note any undocumented functionality that needs coverage

userStories.title: Update README.md
userStories.description: As a new user, I want the README to accurately describe all current FADE capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: README reflects all current commands (init, new, status, run, yolo, export, update, migrate, version)
Installation instructions are current
Quick start guide works with current CLI
Feature list matches implemented functionality
Examples are accurate and functional
Badges and links are valid

userStories.title: Update FADE.md project context
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want FADE.md to reflect the current state of the project
acceptanceCriteria: Tech stack section is accurate
Architecture references are current
Project structure matches actual layout
Any new standards or conventions are documented
Strategic context sections are populated if applicable

userStories.title: Update prompt.md execution protocol
userStories.description: As an AI agent, I want prompt.md to accurately describe current execution expectations
acceptanceCriteria: Signal definitions match current implementation
Story completion workflow is accurate
Test generation instructions are current
All examples reflect actual behavior
Version stamp updated to 0.3.1

userStories.title: Increment version numbers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want all version numbers updated to 0.3.1 consistently
acceptanceCriteria: FADE_VERSION in bin/fade-cli updated to 0.3.1
PROMPT_VERSION in bin/fade-cli updated to 0.3.1
Version in prompt.md header updated to 0.3.1
Any version references in README updated
Version display in fade --version shows 0.3.1

userStories.title: Verify documentation consistency
userStories.description: As a user, I want all documentation to be internally consistent and cross-referenced correctly
acceptanceCriteria: All internal links work (README to other docs)
Command help text matches README descriptions
No references to deprecated or removed features
Standards documents are consistent with coding practices
fade help output matches documented commands

versionLocations: README.md: any version badges or references
technicalNotes.approach: Read each file, compare against current implementation, update discrepancies. Run fade commands to verify help text and behavior match documentation.
